podcast.title: Early Label for The Replacements
podcast.body: Twin/Tone was an early record label for The Replacements, who were initially a hardcore act. "They have a quarter for a label called Twin Tone, and were very much a hardcore-acted first."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Home to The Replacements
podcast.body: Twin/Tone Records was the label for The Replacements during their early career when they were still very much a hardcore act before evolving into a power pop band. "They recorded for a label called Twin Tone"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Local Indie Success
podcast.body: Twin Tone was a local indie label in Minneapolis that signed The Replacements, helping them become stars within the campus radio and indie club circuits. "When they signed to a local indie label called Twin Tone, the bass became stars, at least as far as campus radio and the indie club circuit was concerned."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of Indie Rock: Part 3

podcast.title: Signed The Replacements
podcast.body: The Twin/Tone label, a local independent label based in Minneapolis, signed The Replacements. This signing allowed the band to release their music and gain an audience, contributing to the burgeoning Minneapolis indie scene. "They signed to a local indie label called Twin Tone and put up music like this."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
